Summary: Analytical snapshot: one frozen query-time result for every surface, frozen at lookup settlement, with explicit atomic refresh (implementation of the KRYL-1389 spec)
Description: 1) Original intent: the brief, Target Packet, MAP brief, header state and MAP rings show one analysis. Today each reads the live signal pool on its own schedule, so the same query shows different counts, polarities, pairs and states at different moments (observed across three runs of one question: domain pairs 1, 3, 1; capital magnitude 74, 78, 77; signals 191, 192, 173; and one page showing 97 observations at magnitude 77 beside a panel showing 109 signals at 78). The rubric caps the overall rating at 6 while this gate fails (rubric-alphabet-10of10-20261009.md, Scoring A), so it is the precondition for any rating increase. Governing record: specs/decision-record-evidence-to-formation-build-order-20261010.md (workstream 1). 2) Acceptance criteria: (a) Reproducibility test, Founder 2026-10-10: N = 3 identical runs of the same question with no refresh return identical observation counts, polarities, entity pairs and relationship lists across every relevant surface; compared against the same frozen inputs with the snapshot identity recorded; differences caused by an actual input change belong to a refreshed snapshot, not the repeatability test. (b) One explicit refresh replaces the prior snapshot atomically; every surface reflects the new snapshot; no mixed old and new results during or after refresh. (c) Any unexplained difference between runs, or any cross-surface mismatch during or after refresh, fails the gate. (d) The spec's validation list 1 to 7 passes: stability under pool change, agreement harness (extends qa_brief_reconcile), settlement (all OK, one FAILED, 45-second TIMEOUT, late result changes nothing), refresh with history, no-lookup queries freeze at submit, only Checking before the freeze, and the Full-Gate reachability trace of one real query. (e) Two entities: one registry-resolved and one admitted at runtime. (f) Existing suites stay green: qa_query_corpus, qa_journeys, qa_brief_reconcile, qa_relationshipchange*, qa_ownershiplookup_provenance, qa_brief_done_state_e2e. (g) A failed lookup is shown unavailable, never as absence (absence class b). 3) Current implementation state: specification only (KRYL-1389, in Review; SPEC-analytical-snapshot-implementation-v0.1-DRAFT-20261009.md). No snapshot builder, no snapshots store, no terminal events from the 8-K sync or the capital-realization sync. The ownership lookup outcome is recorded at module level (DEF-1396, ownershiplookupstore.js) and will become part of the snapshot's lookups field. 4) Dependencies: KRYL-1389 spec; DEF-1384, DEF-1392, DEF-1396 (lookup state and notices are preserved); targetpacket.jsx, structuralbrief.jsx, structurepanel.jsx, structure-field.html (MAP iframe), topicconnectors.js, edgar8ksignal.js and capitalrealizationconnector.js (terminal events); KRYL-1334 formation snapshots are a different object and are not merged. Open question to resolve in the build plan before the first edit: the source-dated relationship change block (KRYL-1386) loads after the freeze point and is outside the spec's snapshot contents; either it is included or it is labelled as outside the snapshot. Shared-data gate (CLAUDE.md section 2) applies to every state property the surfaces share. 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: no; KRYL-1389 is the specification this ticket implements. 6) Maps to the current product model: yes (one coherent analysis per query; Direction Honesty; rubric item 5). Status: prepared 2026-10-10 as Ready; implementation not authorized until the Founder's explicit go.
